description.narrative:
The partnership between the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the World Climate Foundation (WCF), with support from Climate Investment Coalition (CIC) is to establish WCF in the role of operating partner for IMCA for a suggested period covering 2023-2026. As IMCA Partner, WCF will support the successful outcomes of IMCA, playing a key role in project planning and coordination, stakeholder outreach and engagement, and communicating its achievements through side events and high-profiled announcements to support IMCA’s role in creating climate investments in emerging markets.
IMCA is a unique partnership between the United States Agency for International Development (USAID), Swedish International Development Cooperation Agency (Sida), Denmark’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Finland’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs (as a starting point, with new country partners to be considered once established). Its role will be to create concrete blended finance investment pipeline collaboration, establish blended finance vehicles, and catalyse private sector funding into climate in emerging markets and developing economies (Official development assistance (ODA) countries specifically).
